QuestInfo.name: Tomo's Lost Backpack
QuestInfo.0: You found #p9310538# in #m701100000#, but #p9310538# won't return to Leafre. Listen to him to find out why.
QuestInfo.1: #p9310538# lost his backpack, which was filled with gifts for the residents of Leafre. The last place #p9310538# remembers carrying the backpack was Nanjing Road. Go there and find the backpack. There's a good chance monsters picked it up.
QuestInfo.2: You recovered the backpack at Nanjing Road but #p9310538#'s expression looks bleak.

default.0: You haven't found the backpack yet? It's totally fine. Please take your time.
